No person, skin, body parts, visible mannequin, hanger, stand, typography, logos or watermark. original_prompt: Reference defines clothing/accessory design only. Create one photorealistic product image, pure white seamless background, portrait 2:3, soft neutral studio lighting, realistic materials, whole item visible with margins. No person, skin, face, hair, braids, visible mannequin, stand, hanger, typography or watermark. Preserve visible reference design; do not invent decoration. Extract ONLY the following accessory, no other garments or accessories. One tiny silver-tone ball-ended nose stud, a minimal polished round ball and a short discreet bent post, no stones, no ring. Product macro view. Reference only shows a tiny silver dot; hidden mounting is an explicitly inferred simple practical construction.
